title: SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for 2536 LDC, JSA and DEO Posts
description: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Combined Higher Secondary Level (CNSL) official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for 2536 LDC, JSA, and DEO Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in Intermediate (10+2) can use this opportunity and apply for the SSC CHSL Recruitment 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. The application process has already started. Int...
